channel.description: Latest press releases from the Minnesota Attorney General's Office

item.title: Attorney General Ellison reaches settlement with Mercedes-Benz USA over emissions fraud
item.description:
Publication Date: December 22, 2025

Eligible consumers have until August 2026 to have approved emission-modification software installed for free and receive $2K payment; 1,600 vehicles registered in Minnesota are affected by settlement

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/12/22_Mercedes-Benz.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues businesses and their owners for defrauding customers by falsely advertising visa services
item.description:
Publication Date: December 22, 2025

Owners of Nueva Vision Latinoamerica LLC charged thousands of customers for promised ‘family reunification’ visas they did not deliver, then used proceeds on luxury cars, designer handbags, and cosmetic surgery while customers and their families suffered

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/12/22_NuevaVision.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues Trump Administration to protect consumers, stop illegal defunding of CFPB
item.description:
Publication Date: December 22, 2025

CFPB has returned $21B to 205M Americans over 14 years; has received 46K complaints from Minnesotans in just the last three years

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/12/22_CFPB.asp
